title: check-hints/<child>.json — how simulation observes the requirements this child realizes
description: One file per child, Wave 2. A hint says how simulation observes requirements.json rows judged simulation and carrying no target: what is observed and against what rule. It names rows, never restates them; materialize inlines each named row's verbatim beside the hint. check-crossrefs: every such row is named by at least one hint across all children; every hint names only such rows; check_id is unique across children.

check_id.description: Unique across every child. testpoints[].covers[] refers to it.

requirements.description: The requirements.json ids this check establishes.

observable.description: The boundary signal, port, or report observed.

reference_rule.description: What the observable is judged against: a reference-model relation, a cycle relation, a tolerance.
